purpose: Rust dynamic toolchain dependencies and controlled compiler environment
limitations: Explicit FIREPROT_RUST_BUILD=1 only; other loaders are not migrated.
Load-time dependencies of declared host objects are verified; late plugins and complete model-environment provenance remain outside the build recipe.
Parallel full-model timings are diagnostic, not a controlled speedup measurement.

cold_build.dependency_scope: Rust-enumerated Torch/ROCm/Python/system headers, GCC trees, Torch libraries and listed compiler/helper files; load-time dependencies of declared compiler tools and HIP runtime are re-resolved in Rust; runtime plugins and the complete model environment remain outside this recipe
